Comment: It's a new type of paint called Thermochromic. It's a surface coating that contains many millions of microcapsules, with a diameter equivalent to the thickness of a human hair. Depending on the chosen setting, stimulation by means of an electrical field causes either the white or the black pigments to collect at the surface of the microcapsule, giving the car body the desired shade.
